summary:
Junior Astronaut Mission Trainer

  Designed for young learners and classrooms, this interactive STEM game puts students in charge of a lunar outpost. Players balance limited power and crew across life support, food production, and radiation shielding, then adapt when events like solar storms and dust plumes disrupt their plans.
                                                             Each choice reveals how mission systems depend on one another, making real engineering trade-offs easier to understand. It’s an engaging way to build systems-thinking skills and inspire students to think like astronauts and engineers.

Junior Astronaut Mission Trainer

Designed for young learners and classrooms, this interactive STEM game puts students in charge of a lunar outpost. Players balance limited power and crew across life support, food production, and radiation shielding, then adapt when events like solar storms and dust plumes disrupt their plans.

Each choice reveals how mission systems depend on one another, making real engineering trade-offs easier to understand. It’s an engaging way to build systems-thinking skills and inspire students to think like astronauts and engineers.
